question: Why will the measure of the worlds be told briefly and what begins the list?
premises: That measure will be told briefly so the mind may quickly pass through it.
The enumeration begins within the cosmic egg.
The first named figures include Ananta, Kāla, Kūṣmāṇḍa and Hāṭaka, and Brahmā and Hari.
inference: A concise account is given to aid rapid mental traversal of the worlds, starting with Ananta and other figures within the egg.
uncertainties: The exact cosmological placement of each named figure depends on the wider compendium context.
plain_english: That will be explained briefly so that the mind may quickly pass through it: within the egg are Ananta, Kāla, Kūṣmāṇḍa and Hāṭaka, and Brahmā and Hari.
